thread:
priya: Hey team — seeing some failures in the vault->k8s secret sync for staging. external-secrets controller logs show 403 on read for path 'secret/data/redwood/staging/*'. Anyone changed policies?

kevin: Which controller? esctl or external-secrets?

priya: Affected pod: external-secrets-controller-5f7c9 in kube-system. Using external-secrets v0.5.3. Logs:
```
ERROR 2026-02-14T09:12:07Z vault: permission denied: token accessor xxxxx
GET /v1/secret/data/redwood/staging/api-key: 403
```

matt: @kevin @anna fyi — I pushed a terraform change last night that tightened Vault policies on the staging role. Could be related. I can roll back if needed.

kevin: Can you paste the policy you applied? Maybe it removed read on that path.

matt: policy snippet:
```hcl
path "secret/data/redwood/*" {
  capabilities = ["list"]
}
```
(notice missing "read")

priya: Yep that's it. ExternalSecrets needs read. We should have capabilities = ["read","list"] for the controller token.

anna: Confirming — external-secrets uses the token created by terraform at module/vault/roles/staging. I'll open a quick PR to add read back.

infra-bot: deploy queued: terraform plan for infra/vault (PR #485) — checks running :gear:

kevin: Quick ask: can we avoid using wildcard "secret/data/redwood/*" and scope to "secret/data/redwood/staging/*"? limits blast radius.

matt: Agreed. PR will scope to staging specifically.

priya: Also note rotation: when we rotate the staging API key, the external-secrets controller should pick up new version automatically if refreshInterval is set. Check manifest:
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1m
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-staging
  target:
    name: staging-api-key
  data:
  - secretKey: api-key
    remoteRef:
      key: secret/data/redwood/staging/api-key
      version: ""
```

kevin: Reminder: controller needs permission to read on secret/metadata/... for listing versions. I think policy should include metadata. e.g. path "secret/metadata/redwood/staging/*" { capabilities = ["list","read"] }

anna: Good catch. I'll add both data and metadata paths in the PR.

matt: Ok changes pushed to branch fix/vault-policy-staging. CI plan shows only metadata and policy changes.

infra-bot: terraform plan finished — no drift.

priya: After policy change, can someone run a quick smoke: `kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/external-secrets-controller | grep staging` and confirm no 403s?

kevin: Running now... no 403s, we see `fetched secret staging/api-key` at 09:56. :thumbsup:

priya: Awesome. I'll mark this as resolved in the issue. Thanks all.

matt: leaving a note in CHANGELOG about mis-scoped policy.

anna: I'll follow up with a small test to simulate rotation and ensure controller refreshes.

kevin: also adding a monitoring alert if controller returns >5% 4xx in an hour.

priya: thanks!
